description: Verbatim window extracts (first 12 x 3072 int16 samples, 64 s apart) from Sierra Nevada ELF station hour files (sensor 0, NS magnetic, fs=256 Hz, raw little-endian int16 ADC counts) inside the Zenodo year archives (records 6348691/6348773/6348838/6348930; CC-BY-4.0; Salinas et al. 2022, Computers & Geosciences 165:105148), fetched by the training pipeline's ranged-GET remote-ZIP reader (size- and CRC-verified members). Labels are GFZ Potsdam definitive Kp (disturbed >= 5, quiet <= 2). Both hours fall in the held-out test years and were re-used unmodified from the pipeline's hour cache.
